attributes.title: Level 5

subgroups.name: solve 1

steps.hints: ❓ What keyword declares a new variable?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ What word is missing from the code that assigns cash an initial random value between 5 and 15?


Solution: 

let should be typed before cash on line 2 to declare the variable.
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, there’s an error in the code! 


Notice that the error message on the bottom says there are problems on Lines 2 and 31: the program cannot find the name ‘cash’.



Fix the bugs in the code so that the cash variable  is declared correctly before it is used in the code.

subgroups.title: Debugging Variables, Concatenation, and Assignment Operators

text.main.ts:
// variable set up
cash = randint(5, 15)

// game set up
scene.setBackgroundColor(9)
game.splash("Press A to buy ice cream.")

// on A button pressed
controller.A.onEvent(ControllerButtonEvent.Pressed, function () {
    let iceCream = sprites.create(img`
        . . . . . 3 3 b 3 3 d d 3 3 . .
        . . . . 3 1 1 d 3 d 1 1 1 1 3 .
        . . . 3 d 1 1 1 d 1 1 1 d 3 1 3
        . . 3 d d 1 1 1 d d 1 1 1 3 3 3
        . 3 1 1 d 1 1 1 1 d d 1 1 b . .
        . 3 1 1 1 d 1 1 1 1 1 d 1 1 3 .
        . b d 1 1 1 d 1 1 1 1 1 1 1 3 .
        . 4 b 1 1 1 1 d d 1 1 1 1 d 3 .
        . 4 4 d 1 1 1 1 1 1 d d d b b .
        . 4 d b d 1 1 1 1 1 1 1 1 3 . .
        4 d d 5 b d 1 1 1 1 1 1 1 3 . .
        4 5 d 5 5 b b d 1 1 1 1 d 3 . .
        4 5 5 d 5 5 d b b b d d 3 . . .
        4 5 5 5 d d d d 4 4 b 3 . . . .
        . 4 5 5 5 4 4 4 . . . . . . . .
        . . 4 4 4 . . . . . . . . . . .
    `, SpriteKind.Player)
    iceCream.x = randint(20, screen.width - 20)
    iceCream.y = randint(20, screen.height - 10)
    iceCream.sayText("$1.50")
    cash -= 0.50
})

subgroups.name: solve 2

steps.hints: ❓What symbols need to be added to correctly concatenate the variable and strings in game.splash?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ What should the message say when the splash screen appears? How might you update the code to show this?


Solution: 

2 plus signs + are added on line 7 to separate the strings and the variable.
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, there’s an error in the code!


Fix the bugs in the code so that when the project begins, a second splash screen appears that tells the user to “Spend their $ [cash value] wisely.”

subgroups.title: Debugging Variables, Concatenation, and Assignment Operators

text.main.ts:
// variable set up
let cash = randint(5, 15)

// game set up
scene.setBackgroundColor(9)
game.splash("Press A to buy ice cream.")
game.splash("Spend your $"  cash  " wisely!")

// on A button pressed
controller.A.onEvent(ControllerButtonEvent.Pressed, function () {
    let iceCream = sprites.create(img`
        . . . . . 3 3 b 3 3 d d 3 3 . .
        . . . . 3 1 1 d 3 d 1 1 1 1 3 .
        . . . 3 d 1 1 1 d 1 1 1 d 3 1 3
        . . 3 d d 1 1 1 d d 1 1 1 3 3 3
        . 3 1 1 d 1 1 1 1 d d 1 1 b . .
        . 3 1 1 1 d 1 1 1 1 1 d 1 1 3 .
        . b d 1 1 1 d 1 1 1 1 1 1 1 3 .
        . 4 b 1 1 1 1 d d 1 1 1 1 d 3 .
        . 4 4 d 1 1 1 1 1 1 d d d b b .
        . 4 d b d 1 1 1 1 1 1 1 1 3 . .
        4 d d 5 b d 1 1 1 1 1 1 1 3 . .
        4 5 d 5 5 b b d 1 1 1 1 d 3 . .
        4 5 5 d 5 5 d b b b d d 3 . . .
        4 5 5 5 d d d d 4 4 b 3 . . . .
        . 4 5 5 5 4 4 4 . . . . . . . .
        . . 4 4 4 . . . . . . . . . . .
    `, SpriteKind.Player)
    iceCream.x = randint(20, screen.width - 20)
    iceCream.y = randint(20, screen.height - 10)
    iceCream.sayText("$1.50")
    cash -= 0.50
})

subgroups.name: solve 3

steps.hints: ❓ Did you try typing an equality operator which checks the value of a variable?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ Which symbol represents an equality operator?


Solution: 

= should be changed to == in the if condition of the controller.menu event code.
steps.instructions:
When the menu button is pressed, nothing happens!


Fix the bugs in the code so that when the menu button is pressed, the if condition checks if the values on both sides are equal, in order to determine what code to run.

subgroups.name: solve 4

steps.hints: ❓Did you try typing a subtraction assignment operator to subtract from the cash variable?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ Which assignment operator subtracts an amount from the variable, then assigns the variable the remaining value?


Solution: 

An equal sign = should be added to the right of the minus sign - in line 32, to create a subtraction assignment operator.
steps.instructions:
When the menu button is pressed, the splash screen says that the full amount of cash is left, even when there are donut sprites on the screen.


Fix the bugs in the code so that each time a new donut sprite is created, 1.50 is subtracted from the cash variable.

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 5 of Blue Belt! In this level, you’ll learn more about assignment and equality operators, which can be used to assign, change, and check for a variable’s value. Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 5:

badges.title: One Equals Sign or Two?
badges.description: Use the correct symbols to create assignment and equality operators to assign, change, and check for a variable’s value in JavaScript.

badges.title: Let There Be Variables
badges.description: Create a variable using let in JavaScript.

badges.title: Concatenation Station
badges.description: Concatenate two or more strings together using the + operator.

badges.title: Asset Depreciation
badges.description: Use the subtraction assignment operator to decrease the value of a number variable.

badges.title: Incremental Growth
badges.description: Use the addition assignment operator to increase the value of a number variable.

badges.title: I’m Thinking of a Number
badges.description: Use the askForNumber function to assign a user-inputted value to a variable.

badges.title: It’s Back on the Menu
badges.description: Write code that runs when the Menu button is pressed.
